title: Brand brain
purpose: When I hand work to an agent, a freelancer or an agency, open Brand brain to give them one true, signed record of the brand, so nothing false, off-brand or already decided gets made.
fires: The founder's memory as the brand record, the old brand deck, the 'what did we decide' Slack search, the pasted notes in every AI chat, and the evenings spent rewriting drafts.
not_for: A solo founder who writes and designs everything alone and briefs no one; until someone else makes work for the brand, their own head is the record.

jobs.job: When I hand a brief to an agent, a freelancer or an agency, give them the same true facts, voice and past decisions I would, so I stop rewriting work that should have been right the first time
jobs.circumstance: Any weekday, a draft ad is back from a freelancer with last season's price and a tone that is not ours, and it has to ship Thursday

progress.functional: every person and agent starts from the same current prices, products, claims, voice and decisions
progress.emotional: stop feeling the brand only exists in my head; stop dreading the review pile
progress.social: look like a founder who runs a tight brand to the agency, the team and a partner

jobs.hire_today: the founder's memory, an old brand deck in a shared drive, and long voice notes to each freelancer
jobs.fire: the old deck, the repeat briefing calls, and rewriting drafts at night

forces.push: a third of drafts come back wrong for a brand reason and I fix them myself
forces.pull: one signed record every person and agent reads first, with the source of each fact
forces.habit: I have always briefed people myself on a call
forces.anxiety: what if the record is wrong and everyone copies the same mistake at scale

jobs.little_hire: every time a brief goes out, and every Monday review of drafts

watch.metric: drafts sent back for a brand reason (wrong fact, off voice, already decided), share of all reviewed drafts, 30 days

drives.metric: drafts approved on the first pass, 30 days

jobs.now_after: Example. Now: 31 percent of drafts go back for a brand reason. After: under 10 percent within 60 days of every brief starting from the signed record.
jobs.not_for: a solo founder who writes and designs everything alone; their head is still the record

jobs.job: When the first draft of the brand record is built from my site, ads and reviews, help me check and sign it in one sitting, so I can trust agents and freelancers to work from it
jobs.circumstance: First week on the new system, the record is drafted from public sources, and nobody should use it until I say it is right

progress.functional: each section marked checked, fixed or not true, with my name and a date
progress.emotional: feel the record is mine, not a machine's guess
progress.social: show the team and the agency this is the signed version

jobs.hire_today: nothing; no brand we see has a signed record today
jobs.fire: the loose pile of decks, docs and notes that each person trusts differently

forces.push: agents are already writing from facts nobody checked
forces.pull: one hour that ends with a signed record
forces.habit: trust the deck from 2 years ago
forces.anxiety: what if I sign something wrong and it spreads everywhere

jobs.little_hire: once at the start, then a short re-sign each quarter

watch.metric: record sections signed by the founder in the last 90 days, share

drives.metric: drafts sent back for a brand reason, 30 days

jobs.now_after: Example. Now: 0 of 22 sections signed. After: 18 of 22 signed in week 1; the other 4 marked open with a question each.
jobs.not_for: a founder who will not give an hour to check it; an unsigned record should not steer anyone

jobs.job: When a draft carries a claim like 'lasts 5 years' or 'clinically proven', tell me if we can prove it before it goes live, so I do not get an ad rejected, a refund wave or a legal letter
jobs.circumstance: A launch ad is set to go tonight, the copywriter added a strong claim, and nobody knows where the proof is

progress.functional: each claim is marked approved with proof, allowed only as the site words it, or banned
progress.emotional: stop the low worry that one line will bring a lawyer's letter
progress.social: look careful to the ad platform, a retail buyer and a lawyer

jobs.hire_today: gut feel, a quick check with the agency, or a paid call to a lawyer for the big ones
jobs.fire: last minute guessing, and the lawyer call for routine claims

forces.push: Meta rejected 5 ads last month for claims and the account got a warning
forces.pull: every claim listed with its proof, date and tier, checked before anything ships
forces.habit: the copywriter says it is fine
forces.anxiety: what if a claim marked safe is not, and I relied on it

watch.metric: claims in live ads and pages with proof on file, share, checked weekly
watch.source: brand brain claims list matched to live Meta ads and site pages

drives.metric: ads rejected or limited for a claim, 30 days

jobs.now_after: Example. Now: 58 of 90 live claims have proof on file. After: 84 of 90 within 30 days; the other 6 reworded or pulled.
jobs.not_for: a brand whose legal team already clears every line before it ships; it needs a log, not a gate
